title: Passage 9
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: The scientific method is used for experiments you do in the classroom.
sentences.cn: 科学方法适用于在课堂上所做的实验。

sentences.en: For example, you blow up a balloon to see how its size changes or use a candle to explore how different materials burn.
sentences.cn: 例如，你通过吹气球来观察它的大小如何变化，或者用蜡烛来探索不同材料是如何燃烧的。

sentences.en: Scientists all over the world use their background knowledge to do experiments, too.
sentences.cn: 全世界的科学家们也在利用他们的背景知识来做实验。

sentences.en: It is a way to avoid drawing conclusions that aren't correct.
sentences.cn: 这是一种避免得出不正确结论的方法。

sentences.en: There are usually four steps in the scientific method, including observation, hypothesis, experiment, and conclusion.
sentences.cn: 科学方法通常有四个步骤，包括观察、假设、实验和结论。

sentences.en: These may not always be completed in the same order,
sentences.cn: 这些步骤并不总是按照相同的顺序完成，

sentences.en: but the first step is usually to ask a question about your observation.
sentences.cn: 但第一步通常是就观察结果提出问题。

sentences.en: You might organise your notes on a desk to make sure that the central idea remains focused.
sentences.cn: 你可以在书桌上整理你的笔记，以确保内容都聚焦于中心思想。

sentences.en: The second step is to state a possible answer to the question.
sentences.cn: 第二步是针对问题给出一个可能的答案。

sentences.en: A good hypothesis includes three things: the explanation for the observations,
sentences.cn: 一个好的假设包括三个方面：对观察的解释，

sentences.en: it is able to be tested,
sentences.cn: 能够被验证，

sentences.en: and it will usually predict new outcomes.
sentences.cn: 通常能预测新的结果。

sentences.en: The third step is the experiment, a test which will either challenge or support your guess.
sentences.cn: 第三步是实验，即一种测试，它要么质疑，要么支持你的猜测。

sentences.en: The hypothesis will then be proved true or false.
sentences.cn: 随后，你的假设将被证明是正确的还是错误的。

sentences.en: The final step is to think about what happened.
sentences.cn: 最后一步是思考发生了什么。

sentences.en: If the results support the hypothesis, a conclusion can be written,
sentences.cn: 如果结果支持这个假设，就可以写下结论，

sentences.en: and you can share it with the rest of the world,
sentences.cn: 并把结论分享给世界上的其他人，

sentences.en: probably by publishing it on a website.
sentences.cn: 可能是通过把它发布在网站上。

sentences.en: This allows anybody interested in the field to learn from your work.
sentences.cn: 这样，任何对该领域感兴趣的人都可以从你的成果中学习。

sentences.en: Then they could conduct their own research anywhere in the world.
sentences.cn: 然后，他们可以在世界上的任一地方开展自己的研究。

sentences.en: So don't forget to check your grammar to present your findings clearly.
sentences.cn: 因此，不要忘记检查你的语法，以清楚地呈现你的研究结果。

sentences.en: If the hypothesis is not supported, you may write a new hypothesis based on the results.
sentences.cn: 如果假设不成立，你则可以基于研究结果写出一个新的假设。
